summary: Lolo NF lookout six miles northwest of Hot Springs, Sanders County; firelookout.com gives a 1934 30-ft L-4 tower destroyed in 1952, and FFLA lists it gone.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1952 per firelookout.com. Forest Lookouts lists it only as Removed, with no date.

events.note: Firelookout.com says destroyed in 1952; Forest Lookouts gives no date

evidence.supports: tower was a 30-foot L-4 tower built in 1934
site is six miles northwest of Hot Springs in Sanders County
site is in the Lolo National Forest
Forest Lookouts (Montana) lists the tower as Removed, with no date
Forest Fire Lookout Association places the site at 47.68268, -114.76832 and lists the tower as gone
site is in Sanders County, Montana

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says destroyed in 1952 and Forest Lookouts says only Removed, with no date. Both imply the tower is gone, so the record keeps gone. Only firelookout.com gives a year.

notes_for_editor: Very thin record. Firelookout.com is the only source with a build year, a destruction year and the elevation. Forest Lookouts and the FFLA list say only Removed or Tower Gone. Two searches found no newspaper, Forest Service or survey source for this tower. Height 9.1 m is converted from 30 ft. No source describes the site today or its access, so no access key is set.
